_doc: The held-out judge's reference sources per tile (tools/probes/held_out.py; docs/held-out-judge.md). park: the NPS unit whose NPSpecies checklist judges the tile's species lists. composition: the independent vegetation measure for the same ground (kind vmi_plots: the NPS Vegetation Mapping Inventory's classification plots, an open-format data package in the NPS DataStore; kind yell_maps: Yellowstone's cover-type and habitat-type maps). A tile outside a park with an open checklist has no entry and its checks report 'no reference'. None of these sources is a pipeline input.
